profile.name: Kartheek Pamidimukkala
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 10 years designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and enterprise platforms. Currently lead AI-native internal apps and enterprise platforms at Meta — reusable multi-agent workflows with tool routing, structured outputs, and human approvals, RAG pipelines, MCP connectors, eval harnesses, and NL-to-SQL data access. Strong in Python backend engineering, system design, enterprise integrations, and data architecture.

achievements: Lead the Tax Data and Revenue Platform serving Finance teams; designed core data architecture — high-throughput ingestion pipelines, target schemas, quality checks, data lineage, and governance — plus a natural-language-to-SQL interface so non-technical stakeholders can safely self-serve data.

Led the design and delivery of an AI tax-audit agent platform that drafts comprehensive responses with structured outputs using RAG over historical audit archives, with human-in-the-loop approvals and full audit trails — reducing audit response times by 90%.

Built secure agent tool interfaces using an MCP-style architecture with tool routing, granting governed access to data and business logic with strict permission and safety boundaries — improving agent response times by 60%.
Led eval and feedback-loop infrastructure for the audit agent — eval harness, regression tests, monitoring, and metrics — raising response accuracy to 90%.

Integrated third-party tax engines and internal finance systems via fault-tolerant APIs with idempotency keys, exponential backoff, and rate-limit handling, ensuring exactly-once processing of revenue transactions.
Designed and implemented high-performance caching services improving application response times by 80%.
Implemented audit trails and role-based permissions for all agent-initiated actions on financial data, meeting internal compliance and SOX audit requirements.
Partnered with system and business owners to turn messy, ambiguous enterprise workflows into reliable internal apps adopted across Finance and operations.
Designed software solutions by analyzing system performance standards, increasing performance efficiency by 20%.
Created IaC templates for deploying scalable microservices to AWS, saving 60% of developer time.
Created guidelines for monitoring and logging for the entire platform.
Architected and optimized high-concurrency backend services to handle extreme traffic scaling, achieving a 300% throughput gain — from 30K to 100K concurrent connections.
Solved cross-region database sync problem required for business-critical flows.
Created a dashboard monitoring the performance of 30 services and provided a standard template adopted across teams.
Mentored junior engineers and led small engineering teams.
Redesigned legacy monolithic infrastructure into decoupled microservices, leveraging robust system design principles to reduce production error rates by 90%.
Mitigated a DDoS attack on the back-end systems by implementing rate limiting.

certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Certificate
Developing ASP.NET MVC Web Application Certificate
